text:
Asking rents in Wiesbaden stand at a median of 14.00 €/m² (2026-06), up 5.3% on the year and +24.1% over five years. That ranks Wiesbaden #10 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 52% above the 2022 average contract rent of 9.21 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 840 € a month in cold rent, 14.9% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 27 days and 26% are gone within a week; with 2.0% market-active vacancy and +2.1% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 14.77 €/m² (+5.5%), with an 80% range of 14.35 to 15.06 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
